split_policy.challenge_assignment: shape-only seeded hash of eligible (N,K) families; all their M values are held out
split_policy.test: new M values in (N,K) families represented in training
split_policy.test_range: Per-case coverage distinguishes interpolation from extrapolation after per-family memory exclusions
split_policy.stress: artificial +1 changes to N and K; separate from model selection and ordinary test
split_policy.source_baseline_exclusion: all 104 already-published baseline shapes are excluded from new test/challenge/stress

weight_policy.interpretation: Architectural operation occurrences under a declared synthetic workload mixture; not observed serving traffic
weight_policy.model_probability: uniform over the five pinned model configurations
weight_policy.m_probability: uniform over the profile's combined train/test M grid before budget exclusions
weight_policy.deduplication: Shared (M,N,K) operations aggregate their weights into a single case and split
weight_policy.stress_weight: uniform, reported separately; no architectural frequency interpretation
weight_policy.budget_exclusions: Remaining weights are normalized only when computing each reported metric; excluded shapes remain listed

scope.operation: Y[M,N] = X[M,K] @ W[N,K].T; preallocated output; no bias/activation in the GEMM target
scope.fused_layout: A separate synthetic alternative concatenates Q/K/V and gate/up output dimensions; it does not prove a deployed framework uses that fusion
scope.m_interpretation: M is the number of rows in one GEMM, not a unique batch/sequence pairing; decode-shaped and prefill-shaped are coverage labels
scope.lm_head: All-token vocabulary projection sweep; actual serving may project only selected token positions
scope.context_length: GEMM row sweeps are shape experiments and may exceed a source model's native context; the decoder-layer validator enforces context limits
scope.budget: 512 MiB bounds ideal input/weight/output tensors only. Runtime checks include free memory, references and rotated buffers and record skips without shrinking model dimensions
scope.runtime: Adaptive graph work and a wall-time budget bound the run; no fixed GPU runtime or accuracy is promised
scope.smoke: The smoke profile checks software plumbing and is not representative performance evidence
